title: Destini Prime 125 (Urban Carbon)
description: The Hero MotoCorp Destini Prime 125 (Urban Carbon) is crafted for effortless city navigation and exceptional fuel economy, positioned in the Commuter Scooter segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 125cc engine generating 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Step-Through Upright riding stance and an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
